name: Ecuador 24-Bus National Planning Case
description: National long-term expansion-planning application of PARAMO using a 24-bus equivalent of the Ecuadorian power system.
public_scope_note: The public 24-bus distribution reports transmission investment at aggregate level; corridor-level optimized build/reconductoring and line-flow variables are outside the public dataset.
geography_note: The public map includes Ecuador planning nodes and contextual Colombia/Peru interconnection markers. External display anchors are identified separately from verified physical substation coordinates.
